subject: Re: minimum order rules for Appleyard & Co
body: If it did case-pack quantities we'd probably pay $19/month for it, but as described it wouldn't cover our main issue.
note: GENUINELY AMBIGUOUS. A conditional, hedged 'probably pay' sits between a requirement and weak interest. PRICE_ACCEPTED is deliberately NOT an accepted answer: 'probably, if' is not acceptance, and the deterministic commitment rules would refuse to count it either way.
